sentences.text: Michael Joseph Jackson -LRB- August 29 , 1958 -- June 25 , 2009 -RRB- was an American singer , songwriter , record producer , dancer , actor , and philanthropist .

Called the `` King of Pop '' , his contributions to music , dance , and fashion along with his publicized personal life made him a global figure in popular culture for over four decades .	Pop	Pop music	King of Pop	Honorific nicknames in popular music	popular culture	popular culture

The eighth child of the Jackson family , Michael made his professional debut in 1964 with his elder brothers Jackie , Tito , Jermaine , and Marlon as a member of the Jackson 5 .	Jackson family	Jackson family	Jackie	Jackie Jackson	Tito	Tito Jackson	Jermaine	Jermaine Jackson	Marlon	Marlon Jackson	Jackson 5	the Jackson 5
He began his solo career in 1971 .
In the early 1980s , Jackson became a dominant figure in popular music .

His music videos , including those of `` Beat It '' , `` Billie Jean '' , and `` Thriller '' from his 1982 album Thriller , are credited with breaking racial barriers and transforming the medium into an art form and promotional tool .	Beat It	Beat It	Billie Jean	Billie Jean	Thriller	Thriller (Michael Jackson album)
The popularity of these videos helped bring the television channel MTV to fame .	MTV	MTV

Jackson 's 1987 album Bad spawned the U.S. Billboard Hot 100 number-one singles `` I Just Ca n't Stop Loving You '' , `` Bad '' , `` The Way You Make Me Feel '' , `` Man in the Mirror '' , and `` Dirty Diana '' , becoming the first album to have five number-one singles on the Billboard Hot 100 .	Bad	Bad (Michael Jackson song)	The Way You Make Me Feel	The Way You Make Me Feel	Man in the Mirror	Man in the Mirror	Dirty Diana	Dirty Diana	Hot 100	Billboard Hot 100

He continued to innovate with videos such as `` Black or White '' and `` Scream '' throughout the 1990s , and forged a reputation as a touring solo artist .	Black or White	Black or White	Scream	Scream/Childhood

Through stage and video performances , Jackson popularized a number of complicated dance techniques , such as the robot and the moonwalk , to which he gave the name .	robot	robot (dance)	moonwalk	moonwalk (dance)
His distinctive sound and style has influenced numerous artists of various music genres .	numerous artists	List of artists influenced by Michael Jackson

Thriller is the best-selling album of all time , with estimated sales of 65 million copies worldwide .	Thriller	Thriller (Michael Jackson album)	best-selling album of all time	List of best-selling albums

Jackson 's other albums , including Off the Wall -LRB- 1979 -RRB- , Bad -LRB- 1987 -RRB- , Dangerous -LRB- 1991 -RRB- , and HIStory -LRB- 1995 -RRB- , also rank among the world 's best-selling albums .	Bad	Bad (Michael Jackson song)	Off the Wall	Off the Wall	Dangerous	Dangerous (Michael Jackson album)	HIStory	HIStory: Past, Present and Future, Book I
He is recognized as the Most Successful Entertainer of All Time by Guinness World Records .	Guinness World Records	Guinness World Records

Jackson is one of the few artists to have been inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame twice , and was also inducted into the Songwriters Hall of Fame and the Dance Hall of Fame as the only dancer from pop and rock music .	rock	Rock music	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Songwriters Hall of Fame	Songwriters Hall of Fame	Dance Hall of Fame	National Museum of Dance and Hall of Fame

His other achievements include multiple Guinness World Records , 13 Grammy Awards , the Grammy Legend Award , the Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award , 26 American Music Awards -- more than any other artist -- including the `` Artist of the Century '' and `` Artist of the 1980s '' , 13 number-one singles in the United States during his solo career -- more than any other male artist in the Hot 100 era -- and estimated sales of over 350 million records worldwide .	Guinness World Records	Guinness World Records	other achievements	Records and achievements of Michael Jackson	Grammy Legend Award	Grammy Legend Award	Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award	Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award	American Music Awards	American Music Awards	number-one singles in the United States	List of artists by number of Billboard Hot 100 number-one singles	Hot 100	Billboard Hot 100
Jackson won hundreds of awards , making him the most awarded recording artist in the history of popular music .	hundreds of awards	List of awards and nominations received by Michael Jackson

He became the first artist in history to have a top ten single in the Billboard Hot 100 in five different decades when `` Love Never Felt So Good '' reached number nine on May 21 , 2014 .	Hot 100	Billboard Hot 100	Love Never Felt So Good	Love Never Felt So Good

Jackson traveled the world attending events honoring his humanitarianism , and , in 2000 , the Guinness World Records recognized him for supporting 39 charities , more than any other entertainer .	Guinness World Records	Guinness World Records

Aspects of Jackson 's personal life , including his changing appearance , personal relationships , and behavior , generated controversy .	appearance	Michael Jackson's health and appearance	personal relationships	Personal relationships of Michael Jackson

In 1993 , he was accused of child sexual abuse , but the civil case was settled out of court for an undisclosed amount and no formal charges were brought .	accused of child sexual abuse	1993 child sexual abuse accusations against Michael Jackson

In 2005 , he was tried and acquitted of further child sexual abuse allegations and several other charges after the jury found him not guilty on all counts .	tried and acquitted	Trial of Michael Jackson

While preparing for his comeback concert series , This Is It , Jackson died of acute propofol and benzodiazepine intoxication on June 25 , 2009 , after suffering from cardiac arrest .	propofol	propofol	benzodiazepine	benzodiazepine	This Is It	This Is It (concerts)	died	Death of Michael Jackson

The Los Angeles County Coroner ruled his death a homicide , and his personal physician , Conrad Murray , was convicted of involuntary manslaughter .	Los Angeles	Los Angeles	Los Angeles County Coroner	Los Angeles County Department of Medical Examiner-Coroner	involuntary manslaughter	involuntary manslaughter
Jackson 's death triggered a global outpouring of grief , and a live broadcast of his public memorial service was viewed around the world .	public memorial service	Michael Jackson memorial service
Forbes ranks Jackson the top-earning dead celebrity , with earnings of $ 825 million in 2016 , the highest yearly amount ever recorded by the publication .	Forbes	Forbes
